VKF native versus WebAssembly browser benchmark

Workload: spectral-norm-small. 10 warmups and 100 measured runs per cell.

All measurements use the same VKF source on one macOS host. macOS is the common host that can run Chrome, Firefox, and Safari.

VKF runtimeMean ± sample SDRelative to native
Native (arm64)0.081 ± 0.004 ms1.00×
WebAssembly · Chrome (V8)0.115 ± 0.032 ms1.41×
WebAssembly · Firefox (SpiderMonkey)0.112 ± 0.037 ms1.37×
WebAssembly · Safari (JavaScriptCore)0.113 ± 0.027 ms1.39×

Informational same-host comparison. No performance threshold is enforced.

The relative column is batched warm WebAssembly kernel time per operation divided by raw native VKF kernel time on the same host.

Compile, cold instantiate+execute, warm-kernel raw samples and CI95 are in the JSON report. No aggregate score or release-performance claim is made.
